question: Which Excel feature allows you to simultaneously edit the same cell or range of cells with multiple users in real-time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**co-authoring**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Co-authoring** in Excel enables multiple users to work on the same spreadsheet simultaneously,

 
 
• making real-time edits and seeing each other's changes as they happen.
 
• This feature is particularly useful for collaborative projects where multiple individuals need to work on the same data.
 
 
 
• For example, a team of accountants might use co-authoring to collaborate on a financial report, while a group of students could use it to work on a group project.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Data Validation:**

 
 
• This feature is used to restrict the type of data that can be entered into a cell or range of cells.
 
 
 
• **Conditional Formatting:**
 
 
• This feature allows you to apply different formatting to cells based on specific conditions.
 
 
 
• **Track Changes:**
 
 
• This feature allows you to track the changes made to a document, including who made the changes and when.
